criteria.name: Photoreal texture & grain
criteria.measures: pore/fabric/sand detail; grain and halation per scene DNA 3.1; no smoothing (R-18)

criteria.name: Anatomy & performance truth
criteria.measures: faces, hands, teeth, gaits, micro-beats per 09; identity vs lock still

criteria.name: Physical plausibility
criteria.measures: gravity, contact, archery/equine/fire/smoke physics per 08 8.4-8.5 and 13

criteria.name: Lens & camera grammar
criteria.measures: focal/stop feel, DoF, flare character, move per 08

criteria.name: Light & color continuity
criteria.measures: palette family, ratios, kelvin story, value escalation per 03

criteria.name: Temporal stability
criteria.measures: no flicker/boil/warp across duration; HOLD elements hold

criteria.name: Motion quality & cadence
criteria.measures: 1/48 s blur feel, 24 fps cadence, amplitude per shot DNA

criteria.name: Prompt / plate adherence
criteria.measures: beats present in order; framing vs plate overlay

anchors.5: Theatrical: indistinguishable from photographed live-action at 100% inspection; zero noted defects
anchors.4: Acceptable: defects only visible at freeze-frame/zoom, not in real-time viewing; no DNA violation
anchors.3: Remediable: visible defect in real-time but fixable in post at bounded cost
anchors.2: Reject-soft: defect violates a shot-DNA lock or needs unbounded post; candidate rejected
anchors.1: Reject-hard: hard-stop risk instance or anatomy/physics break

panel.disagreement_rule: spread >1 point on any criterion triggers discussion re-score; persistent split: director's score governs (human authority)

model_comparison_mode: identical prompt/plate batches across candidate models; compare mean weighted score per shot and hard-stop incidence; per-shot winners allowed; selection rationale recorded with human sign-off
